item.title: MET and Shell sign MoU on US LNG co-operation
item.description: MET International AG and Shell have signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding to expand their existing long-term co-operation in LNG and gas trading.

item.title: Adriatic LNG supplied over 13% of national gas demand in 2025
item.description: The Adriatic LNG terminal injected 8.2 billion m3 of natural gas into the grid in 2025, covering more than 13% of national gas demand.

item.title: NGUYA FLNG achieves first LNG cargo
item.description: The launch ceremony of the first NGUYA FLNG cargo loading was recently held for Eni’s NGUYA FLNG offshore Pointe-Noire, Republic of the Congo.

item.title: Naftogaz to deliver US LNG via Klaipeda terminal for first time
item.description: Naftogaz Group, in co-operation with Ignitis Group, has secured the supply of 90 million m3 of US LNG to be delivered to Ukraine via the LNG terminal in Lithuania.

item.title: Cheniere and CPC sign long-term LNG SPA
item.description: Cheniere Energy, Inc. has entered into a long-term LNG sale and purchase agreement with CPC Corp., Taiwan.

item.title: Venture Global announces new long-term LNG partnership with Hanwha
item.description: Venture Global, Inc. and Hanwha Aerospace Co., Ltd have executed a new sales and purchase agreement for the purchase of 1.5 million tpy of US LNG from Venture Global for 20 years.

item.title: Yang Ming container vessel completes first LNG bunkering
item.description: Through close collaboration with the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore and Shell Eastern Trading (Pte) Ltd, Yang Ming’s lead container vessel, YM Willpower, bunkered around 3500 t of LNG in Singapore

item.title: TotalEnergies signs LNG export agreement with Alaska LNG project
item.description: TotalEnergies has signed a preliminary agreement with Glenfarne for the long-term offtake of 2 million tpy of LNG from the Alaska LNG project over 20 years.

item.title: DOE approves export expansion at Corpus Christi LNG
item.description: The U.S. Secretary of Energy has signed an export authorisation for a 12% expansion in exports at Cheniere Energy’s Corpus Christi LNG terminal.

item.title: Collett delivers wind turbines to Dragon LNG
item.description: Collett has completed the delivery of three Enercon E-138 wind turbines to the Dragon LNG facility.
